intent.proves: Visible Edit user, Change password and Manage addresses apps are all placed.
intent.scope: distinct app system names among active UserEdit, UserChangePassword and UserAddresses paragraphs on active pages

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ParagraphModuleSystemName) FROM Paragraph p JOIN Page g ON g.PageId = p.ParagraphPageId WHERE p.ParagraphDeleted = 0 AND p.ParagraphShowParagraph = 1 AND g.PageDeleted = 0 AND g.PageActive = 1 AND p.ParagraphModuleSystemName IN ('UserEdit','UserChangePassword','UserAddresses')
